verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents multilingual conversations, language detection, or mid-call language switching. The voice, transcription-mode and basic-settings docs never mention languages. The only related item is a community quote in which the founder calls multilingual support a roadmap item, which shows the capability was not shipped at the time.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run conversations in multiple languages, including detecting and switching language mid-call
